{{Top|leg}}
'''ARCHIVE-H''' was an enigmatic and successful [[Information broker/Legends|infochant]] working in the [[Ringali Shell]], who only communicated with clients over [[Pirate/Legends|pirated]] [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] transmissions. ARCHIVE-H charged a variable fee, informed by an inexplicable ability to accurately judge what a client could afford. Low-priority information could typically be acquired for 10-100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], while sensitive information, ARCHIVE-H's specialty, could cost as much as a million credits. These fees would be transferred through a maze of secured financial accounts. ARCHIVE-H's high prices were justified by the infochant's nearly perfect success rate in acquiring whatever information a client required.<ref name="FOP">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref>
